title: labels 1 3 words sentence case i18n
rule: Labels 1–3 words, sentence case, no articles/punctuation; independent sentences (not the first half of a sentence finished by the options) — i18n.
pass_when: Label is 1–3 words, sentence case, no articles/punctuation, and a full independent sentence (options don’t complete the label).
fail_when: Long label, Title Case, articles/punctuation, or “Choose your…” finished by the options (breaks i18n).
overview: Labels are 1–3 words, sentence case, independent—not completed by options.
apply_when: Writing select and choice labels that must translate cleanly.
not_when: Long Title Case labels, articles/punctuation, or options finishing the label.
agent_hint: Write 1–3 word sentence-case labels as independent sentences; options must not complete them.
description: Labels are 1–3 words, sentence case, with no articles or punctuation, and form independent sentences—not the first half of a sentence finished by the options—for i18n. Pass when the label meets those constraints and options do not complete it. Fail for long labels, Title Case, articles or punctuation, or patterns like “Choose your…” finished by the options.
do_not_claim: GOV.UK no-colons / Fluent top-align as this word-count rule. Overlap with Forms 54: beyond LIVE `visible_label` / `label_stays_visible`.
